title: Saved by the Coupon
description:
You're a new professional who just got your first paycheck. After a brief taste of "financial freedom," you have a sudden realization—the money is all gone.

Looking at the measly 100-something bucks left in your bank account and seeing over twenty days left until the next payday... You realize a harsh survival challenge has begun.

・Become a "Coupon Master"

The core gameplay revolves around a simulated smartphone. To survive, you must become a savvy "Delivery Discount Hunter."

There are various ways to collect deals in the game. Scoring a "$0 Order" is a badge of honor for the truly sharp-eyed player.

・Life on Your ScreenSurvival isn't just about eating. As you struggle, the social media apps on your phone are buzzing. Your family, friends, and even your boss will keep messaging you. Every social interaction could unlock hidden storylines, bringing unexpected help... or more trouble.

・Game FeaturesAn Authentic "Spend-it-All" Experience: Feel the dramatic shift from 'splurging' to 'penny-pinching'.

Rich Storylines with Multiple Endings: Your choices don't just affect your hunger; they determine your relationships and your future.

Simulated Phone System: All interactions (ordering food, chatting, checking your balance) happen on one fully functional virtual smartphone.

The Absurd Tale of a "Work-Drone": A realistic story about modern youth's consumer habits, independent life, and relationships.

Can you make it to payday with just over 100 bucks and a pile of coupons?
description_short: Your salary is gone, and payday is still a whole month away. Open your phone, pinch every penny, and make the most of every food delivery coupon. Can you survive until the next payday?
